info.title: API-DocTest-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Airline Flight Reservations API allows users to initiate the cancellation of flight bookings. This endpoint is designed for travel agencies, airlines, and customers wishing to manage their flight reservations efficiently. By using this API, consumers can programmatically cancel specific flights, ensuring that all relevant booking information is handled properly. Ideal for integration into customer service platforms, this feature enhances the user experience by simplifying the process of managing travel itineraries.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel an existing flight booking. Provide the necessary details to successfully process the cancellation request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details for canceling a flight. Please provide the necessary information in the JSON format to successfully process your cancellation request.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: The request body for canceling a flight operation. This string should represent the details required to process the cancellation request.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.title: Cancel Flight Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the flight after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The amount of time taken to process the cancellation, in milliseconds.

message.description: Informative message related to the cancellation operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for a successful flight cancellation operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the auditing of the cancellation request.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken, in milliseconds, to process the request. This value helps in understanding the performance and efficiency of the operation.
